gcp_pci_bigquery_dataset_a4e25dbf9640.summary: Remove the reviewed BigQuery dataset ACL entry granting allUsers READER access.
steps: Read the exact dataset's FULL access list and identify the entry whose specialGroup is allUsers and role is READER; confirm the data owner's intended audience.
Arrange approved replacement access for the callers that need it, then remove only that allUsers READER entry through the reviewed dataset access-control change.
Read back the FULL dataset access list, verify the exact pair is absent, and separately review any other public grants or inherited access.
caveats: Removing a public reader grant can break anonymous consumers; coordinate the access change with the data owner.
This exact signed predicate does not assess allAuthenticatedUsers, WRITER, OWNER, iamMember, project, or inherited IAM grants; separate checks may report those risks.
